story_description: Build the settings window foundation, navigation, categories, and search.
task_description: Settings are organized into 12 logical categories. An enum provides type-safe category handling with associated metadata (icon, title).
atom_description: Settings are organized into 12 logical categories. An enum provides type-safe category handling with associated metadata (icon, title).
problem_statement: Settings are organized into 12 logical categories. An enum provides type-safe category handling with associated metadata (icon, title).
scope_in: Define SettingsCategory enum with 12 cases; provide display name and SF Symbol icon for each
Implement SettingsCategory.swift according to the problem statement and functional requirements.
scope_out: Exclude work assigned to other atoms or features in this epic.
assumptions: SF Symbols are available for all needed icons
Blaze app builds successfully with `swift build` before work begins
@AppStorage is the persistence mechanism for user preferences
Actor-based stores (HookStore pattern) are the standard for data persistence
constraints: Enum must be CaseIterable for sidebar iteration
Icons must use SF Symbols (no custom assets)
Must not block main UI thread
Must use glass styling via DSGlass for all settings panels
Must persist state across app restarts
All user-facing strings must be localizable (use String constants)
No third-party dependencies without explicit approval
Default window size 1200 x 800 and resizable
Transparent titlebar with traffic lights visible
Background clear, isOpaque false, shadow enabled
functional_requirements: Define enum cases: appearance, chat, security, engines, terminal, agents, files, notifications, cliPower, memory, git, hooks
Provide `icon: String` (SF Symbol name) computed property
Use DSGlass styling for any settings panels or UI surfaces.
nonfunctional_requirements: Must not block the main UI thread.
All user-facing strings must be localizable.
implementation_steps: Review the SettingsCategory.swift section in docs/settings-development.md and confirm required fields and flows.
data_model_changes:
enum SettingsCategory: String, CaseIterable, Identifiable {
case appearance
case chat
case security
case engines
case terminal
case agents
case files
case notifications
case cliPower
case memory
case git
case hooks
var id: String { rawValue }
var displayName: String {
switch self {
case .appearance: return "Appearance"
case .chat: return "Chat & Input"
case .security: return "Security & Trust"
case .engines: return "Engines"
case .terminal: return "Terminal"
case .agents: return "Agents"
case .files: return "Files & Editor"
case .notifications: return "Notifications"
case .cliPower: return "CLI Power"
case .memory: return "Memory & Context"
case .git: return "Git"
case .hooks: return "Hooks Builder"
}
}
var icon: String {
switch self {
case .appearance: return "paintbrush"
case .chat: return "bubble.left.and.bubble.right"
case .security: return "lock.shield"
case .engines: return "gearshape.2"
case .terminal: return "terminal"
case .agents: return "person.3"
case .files: return "doc.text"
case .notifications: return "bell"
case .cliPower: return "command"
case .memory: return "brain"
case .git: return "arrow.triangle.branch"
case .hooks: return "link"
}
}
}
